uncertain_sources: The automatic transcript drops subscripts throughout the opening definitions; the board and surrounding explanation establish P_i and E_i unambiguously.
A verbal algebra slip near 00:18:50 reverses a temperature ratio; solving T_A dS_A + T_B dS_B = 0 gives dS_B = -(T_A/T_B)dS_A.
The lecture describes coarse-graining qualitatively; the chapter distinguishes coarse-grained entropy growth from preservation of fine-grained entropy under exact Hamiltonian evolution.
The classical state discussion informally suggests replacing sums by integrals; the chapter notes the required phase-space measure and quantum-to-classical limiting argument.
The lecture says all subleading Stirling factors cancel; the chapter retains only the correct leading extensive result and identifies the remaining logarithmic corrections.

The response around 01:17:31 contains a verbal reversal about occupation-number distributions; the chapter preserves the intended distinction between equally weighted micro-arrangements and multiplicity-weighted macrostates.
The multi-constraint homework example changes its second constraint while being written; the final simple linear version is retained only as a method exercise.
The lecture calls temperature a Lagrange multiplier; with the displayed entropy convention, the energy-conjugate multiplier is inverse temperature up to sign.
